title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:2:00011:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8-2 (Notification of Summary of Service Evaluation Results, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Justice may notify the prosecutor subject to a service evaluation of a summary of the evaluation results in any of the following cases:
1. Where the prosecutor has been notified to appear before the Prosecutors' Qualification Review Committee under Article 39 (5) of the Act;
2. Where the prosecutor applies to be notified of a summary of service evaluation results (limited to the results for a particular period determined by the Minister of Justice) and the cumulative service evaluation results for that period are significantly unsatisfactory.
(2) A prosecutor notified of service evaluation results under paragraph (1) 2 may submit a written opinion on the summary of his or her service evaluation results to the Minister of Justice within two weeks from the date of notification.
(3) Upon receipt of a written opinion under paragraph (2), the Minister of Justice may notify the contents thereof to the service evaluator whose evaluation is relevant to the matters stated in the written opinion and have the evaluator submit a written opinion thereon.
(4) The Minister of Justice shall retain written opinions under paragraphs (2) and (3), together with the service evaluation results under Article 8.
(5) A prosecutor notified of a summary of service evaluation results under paragraph (1) 2 shall not disclose the contents thereof.
